b: We run a Brazilian news site covering gaming, entertainment and pop culture. We’d been growing for months. Then the November core update started rolling out and our traffic fell off a cliff.

Update (Nov 16) — The drop showed up in Google Search Console’s Web Search report. We were reaching about 80,000 Search clicks a day before the drop. GSC has reported around 3,000 clicks so far for Nov 16, and that day’s count is still partial. Search impressions fell sharply too.

For context, the numbers in the title are total site pageviews. Our site analytics showed roughly 94k pageviews on Nov 10, 66k on Nov 11, 23k on Nov 12 and 16k on Nov 13. We were still around 16k on Nov 15. That’s an 83% drop in three days.

Has anyone running a news site, especially in gaming or entertainment, seen a similar drop in Web Search since Nov 10? If you’ve diagnosed one before, what helped you figure out whether a few high-traffic stories accounted for most of the drop or whether older guides and other evergreen pages lost visibility too?
